newsitem.title: UK: Lowe Group enters Colombian market.
newsitem.headline: Lowe Group enters Colombian market.

text.p: The Lowe Group's advertising network, Lowe and Partners Worldwide, said on Friday it had established operations in Colombia by taking a minority stake in an agency in Bogota.
Lowe & Partners, which is part of Interpublic Group of Cos Inc, said it had taken a minority shareholding in Sokoloff Samper Polar Mora (SSPM).

The Colombian agency will be renamed Lowe & Partners/SSPM and will become part of the recently-established Lowe & Partners Latin American division, which also includes Lowe Loducca in Brazil and Lowe & Partners/SMS in Mexico.

"This new partnership represents the next step forward for us in Latin America. This region is not only showing double-digit growth in terms of advertising expenditure, it also harbours exciting creative talent," said Frank Lowe, chairman and founder of the Lowe Group.
